# Shared geometry fixtures

`geometry.csv` contains 1,632 deterministic cases for the h2histogram design.
Columns: grouping power, maximum value power, input value, bucket index,
inclusive lower/upper bounds, and total number of buckets. All integers are
decimal unsigned values. The gp30/max31 cases test geometry only and must not
allocate a dense histogram.

Generated by an independent Python integer interval reference with fixed seeds,
then every row was checked by compiling the Rust `Config` implementation from
`iopsystems/histogram` commit `0bf38c2bc68de286f823ed94b679a567b3ea2052`
(version 1.6.1-alpha.0; README-only successor to 05c5af9). The C and Zig drafts
consume identical copies. No performance conclusions follow from these fixtures.

Regenerate the deterministic CSV with `python3 tests/fixtures/generate.py`.
